comment: Cotropia made a 1pm Friday class something to look forward to. Great textbook (thats FREE) and very clear lectures. 1000% would recommend.

Cotropia is hysterically funny, very very helpful, and truly wants his students to learn. He made an 8:30AM class something we looked forward to. One not of caution, don't try to anticipate what is on the final, because you will have NO idea! That being said, I still got a B.

Prof. Cotropia is super nice and is one of the best professors to have at 8am (a crappy class time, but he makes it a bit better.) He's always willing to help you out. Certain concepts can be difficult, but he is willing to go over it multiple times if needed. Also calls names alphabetically, so you know when you will be called.
